Hmm, if the component is a tree (connected, v_C - 1 edges), can it contain a loop? A loop makes vertex connectivity... a connected multigraph with v vertices and v-1 edges is a tree and has no loops. So fine — loops only appear in components with cycles, which we discard. But wait: could a loop edge force every component to have e_C ≥ v_C? We need some component with e_C < v_C.
